column1: #   name               - Short identifier used in job names and output paths (no spaces).
#   input_dir          - Xenium output directory (the outs/ folder or equivalent).
#   he_image           - Path to H&E image file. Leave blank if no H&E is available.
#   lasso_file         - Path to LASSO region file (GeoJSON or CSV/TSV).
#   walltime_data_only - LSF walltime for the --skip-images run  (HH:MM format).
#   ram_gb_data_only   - RAM in GB for the --skip-images run.
#   walltime_with_images - LSF walltime for the full run including images (HH:MM format).
#   ram_gb_with_images - RAM in GB for the full run including images.
